description: This Python source file provides utility functions to manage environment variable mappings between a common format and framework-specific formats using YAML templates. It includes functions to locate templates, parse YAML configurations, apply prefix mappings, and convert environment variable dictionaries in both directions.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Determines the path to the environment template file for a specified framework based on the current file's directory.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file, extracting an optional prefix and a dictionary mapping framework-specific environment variables to common variables.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Adds a specified prefix to all environment variable names in a given dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Maps a dictionary of common environment variables to framework-specific variables using a YAML template, applying direct mappings, prefix rules, and defaulting to original names.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts framework-specific environment variables back to the common format, considering direct mappings, prefixes, and remaining variables.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Returns a list of framework names based on directories containing an 'env.template' file in the current directory.

ctags.pattern: /^def apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str) -> Dict[str, str]:$/
